employee_contributions.formula_readable: Associates are always 100% vested in their own Associate Elective Contributions (pre-tax, Roth, and catch-up), pre-2008 after-tax contributions, and rollover contributions.

nonelective.formula_readable: Associates are 100% vested in the 3% Basic Non-Elective Company Contributions immediately upon receipt.

employer_match.formula_readable: Associates become 100% vested in Matching Company Contributions after completing two years of service. If an associate leaves before two years, unvested Matching Company Contributions are forfeited. Associates also become 100% vested upon reaching age 65, becoming permanently and totally disabled, or dying during the plan year.

Capital One matches 100% of the first 3% of eligible pay contributed and 50% of the next 3% of eligible pay contributed. The maximum Matching Company Contribution is 4.5% of eligible pay. Associates must contribute at least 6% of eligible pay to receive the maximum match. Matching contributions are not made on amounts over 6% of eligible pay.

nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: Each pay period Capital One contributes 3% of eligible pay regardless of whether the associate is actively contributing to the Plan. Associates are 100% vested in these contributions immediately.

eligibility.formula_readable: Associates are eligible to participate in the Associate Savings Plan if they are at least 18 years of age and are a full-time or part-time associate of Capital One or an affiliate that has adopted the Plan. Participation begins on the first day of work.
